Narrow value, not a synonym for 'has a URL' — nearly every item has a URL and still doesn't carry this tag. Reserve it for content whose delivery mechanism is itself the point (a hosted platform/tool), not plain web-hosted text or video.

Media-format signal only. Before Content Type existed as a separate key here, this was the only place assessment-purpose signal could go, so it was under-applied on plain downloadable quizzes/rubrics; that purpose signal now belongs primarily on Content Type (`Assessment`), with this tag reserved for content whose delivery format is itself assessment-flavoured (e.g. an online test platform).
